release_notes.title: ClickUp tool results and Blender command lists
release_notes.summary: ClickUp reads large tool results through complete retained pages and correctly selects Blender when its catalog request places server outside params.
improved: Send ClickUp-sized result pages while keeping every original character available through plazcode_result_read, without rerunning the original tool.
Recheck final tool feedback after appended status and reference context.
fixed: Large Blender results and full command references no longer exceed ClickUp’s outgoing transport bound.
Read-only command-list requests preserve an unambiguous top-level server selector; conflicting selectors are rejected.
notes: Exact-source Windows/macOS/Linux/browser and packaged Mac desktop checks are required before publication.
Browser fixtures use a mocked bridge; affected live ClickUp accounts and real Blender/Studio work are not claimed tested. Windows is unsigned; macOS is not notarized.

release_notes.title: Reliable ClickUp startup receipts
release_notes.summary: ClickUp startup continues after accepted context parts, uses compact defaults, and stops clearly when the selected AI model declines the connection.
improved: Use compact default ClickUp startup instructions and bounded saved-note previews; keep full notes available through the memory reader and preserve custom instructions exactly.
Observe a startup acknowledgement through the existing response timeout when its receipt is delayed.
fixed: Confirm each startup context part from a persisted new user row and its exact new assistant acknowledgement when rich-text rendering changes the user row.
Recognize explicit ClickUp model refusals before sending a protocol correction; leave startup stopped and the composer unlocked.
Cancel receipt observation on Stop or a known conversation change without sending again.
notes: Validated on Windows, macOS and Linux with Chromium/Firefox regressions and packaged macOS desktop checks before publishing.
Affected live ClickUp accounts were not reproduced. AI models can still decline the connection request. Windows is unsigned; macOS is not notarized.

release_notes.title: ClickUp, Ultra and recoverable Skills
release_notes.summary: Use PlazCode in ClickUp Brain and existing AI-agent chats, activate the unified Ultra effort, recover deleted skills, and find clearly labelled donation links.
added: ClickUp Ask Brain and existing AI-agent chats support the usual PlazCode Studio, Blender and local-file commands.
Deleted Skills tab with Restore, confirmed permanent deletion and a separate Delete All for deleted items.
Desktop Donations page after Templates with labelled 50, 100, 500 and 1,000 Robux links opening in the current/default browser.
improved: Ultra replaces the visible UltraCode effort label and adds animated gradient text with reduced-motion and forced-colour accessibility fallbacks.
UltraCode and UltraGUI work as hidden internal components; relevant UltraLab companion enhancements activate only at Ultra effort. The eleven starter skills remain visible.
ClickUp startup sends bounded, acknowledged context parts without truncating instructions or automatically replaying uncertain sends.
Updated donation destinations and amounts everywhere in the shared bar settings and desktop page.
fixed: ClickUp toolbar follows the actual chatbox width and position while Ask/Agents tabs stay visible and clickable.
Injected ClickUp startup/tool messages stay hidden after UI remounts; failed startup cannot restore a false Ready state.
Removed Condo Lock classification, strikes and cooldown lockouts across all supported providers, including migration of old stored locks. Other permissions and safety controls are unchanged.
notes: User-tested build 3 was approved for publication after successful ClickUp use. Exact-source Windows/macOS/Linux and Chromium/Firefox CI passed; packaged macOS desktop lifetime checks gate publication.
Older hard-deleted skills cannot be recovered. Permanent deletion is irreversible through PlazCode, not forensic erasure of external backups.
UltraLab is a bundled reference toolkit with scoped task routing. External services, credentials, dependencies and asset rights remain subject to setup and verification.
Windows is unsigned; macOS is ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Custom agents and real affected Studio/Blender/file projects are not claimed as exhaustively live-tested.

release_notes.title: Skills, connection and Blender fixes
release_notes.summary: The approved test build 6: faster startup, reliable connection status, improved Skills controls, a one-click Save as skill card, and the user-tested Blender screenshot and dashboard fixes.
added: Favourite stars and two-click skill deletion. Delete all keeps favourites, starter skills, UltraGUI references and shared workflows.
A one-click Save as skill card above the chat box for lasting preferences. It closes after 45 seconds without hover or focus; closing saves nothing.
improved: MCP add-ons start in parallel in the background instead of blocking Studio startup.
Up to 8 favourite skills are always included within their project, engine and domain, followed by the 3 best other matches.
Short task checklist labels on other providers; Notion keeps its established startup wording.
Packaged launchers, Firefox extension copies and checksum manifests now match the reviewed source.
fixed: False disconnected status and stale dashboard connection labels.
Blender screenshots use an off-screen viewport capture and a unique receipt; no stale image is returned without a receipt.
Automatic completed-task skill candidates are disabled, duplicate saves are refused, and untouched duplicate candidates are cleaned up.
Clarification panels no longer sit behind overlays; the typing mask is lifted while questions wait.
Native paste and editing shortcuts work in PlazCode text boxes on pages with capture handlers.
Claude waits for an enabled Send control instead of clicking a guessed composer button.
OS Error 1450 recovery, provider startup handshakes and verifiably unsent Notion tool results.
notes: The user approved test build 6 for publication. Exact-source automated checks passed on Linux, Windows and macOS, with Chromium/Firefox and real Blender CI checks. Live provider accounts and real Roblox Studio imports were not tested by CI.
The user-tested Studio heal guard is preserved. Automatic helper restart remains inactive because the bridge has no mcp_status handler.
Windows binaries are unsigned. The Mac app is ad-hoc signed, not notarized. GLM HTML server errors are unchanged.
